description: §19.16.5 — a body-split function whose FIRST server batch fails still runs its deferred bodies on the way out: the batch's error return is an exit of the function body. The stubbed server error makes batch 0 fail, so the client work after it never runs, but @busy is cleared and "D;" is appended: trace = "start;D;", @busy = false.
rationale: §19.16.5: the deferred body also runs when an intermediate batch fails and the function returns its error envelope (§19.6.7); §19.16.2 lists the implicit CPS failure return among the exits. serverStub declares an impl-neutral server error for every batch of `save`.
